- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–2% for next period.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.33), model underestimates; adjust upward by 1–2% if recent price is falling.
- Model consistently overreacts to short-term spikes (e.g., +5%+ in 1–2 days); cap forecast increase to 3% max after spike.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3–5 consecutive days show downward trend, model often fails to reverse; add 0.5–1.5% upward bias in next forecast.
- Forecast horizon 30d: model often lags by 1–2 days in price correction; align forecast with 1–2 day lagged true value if sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.
- If sentiment history shows alternating +/– cycles, model tends to misalign with sentiment direction; match forecast slope to sentiment trend direction.
